description: This file defines a servlet filter class 'AppAuthUserFilter' that extracts the 'X-Auth-Id' header from incoming HTTP requests, logs the value, and sets it in a thread-local context for downstream processing. It then clears the context after processing the request.

classes.name: AppAuthUserFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that intercepts HTTP requests to extract user authentication information from headers and manages context accordingly.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes the incoming request to extract the 'X-Auth-Id' header, logs it, sets the authentication ID in the context, and ensures context clearing after the filter chain execution.
